\[
\text{Average} = \frac{\text{lines} + \text{words} + \text{characters}}{3}
\]

---

### Example (using the sample data you gave)

| Metric      | Value |
|-------------|-------|
| Lines       | 3     |
| Words       | 9     |
| Characters  | 48    |

\[
\text{Average} = \frac{3 + 9 + 48}{3} = \frac{60}{3} = 20
\]

So the average of those three counts would be **20**.

---

If you want to compute this for your actual file, just replace the numbers above with the real counts you get from `wc` (or any other tool you use). The formula stays the same.
